import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,sys,hashlib
lane=Path.cwd();w=str(lane/'write_lane.py')
def write(n,s):subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',w,n],input=s,text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
frozen=json.loads(Path('frozen-after.json').read_text());assert not frozen['mismatches']
r=json.loads(Path('results.json').read_text());r['328744']['ordinary_gate']['precise_gap_or_attribution']+=' Final recovery: original1409.1874v2 p4 Note added in proof explicitly states Letzter gave examples proving Conjecture2.3 false. Source-own public resolution, zero.';write('results.json',json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
s=Path('ACTUALBRIEF.md').read_text();s=s.replace('Frozen-after and exhaustive own-lane noncircular manifest are finalized after this brief. Final seal explicitly lists terminal self-exclusions.','Frozen-after: all13 bindings checked, no mismatches. SEAL.json contains the exhaustive own-lane SHA256 manifest and precisely named terminal noncircular self-exclusions. Original cycle source p4 note added in proof itself states Conjecture2.3 false, recovered after initial notes; no novelty attaches. No failed completed runner receipts observed before terminal seal.');write('ACTUALBRIEF.md',s)
s=Path('SUSTAINED-ROUTES.md').read_text();s+='\nFinal source recovery: original1409.1874v2 p4, immediately following Conjecture2.3, explicitly records Letzter\'s examples showing that exact conjecture is false. This strengthens the source-own-public exclusion without claiming an independent adjacency audit.\n';write('SUSTAINED-ROUTES.md',s)
ex=['SEAL.json','seal.receipt.json','seal.output.txt'];manifest={}
for p in sorted(lane.rglob('*')):
 if not p.is_file():continue
 rel=str(p.relative_to(lane))
 if rel in ex:continue
 assert not p.is_symlink();manifest[rel]={'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'bytes':p.stat().st_size}
write('SEAL.json',json.dumps({'kind':'exhaustive-own-lane-SHA256','files':manifest,'terminal_self_exclusions':ex,'reason':'SEAL cannot hash itself; current runner output and receipt finalize after its child exits. All other completed receipts, outputs, helpers, plans, search responses, charge and GET ledgers, locks, raw literals, source processing, frozen-after and handoff files included.','frozen_count':13,'frozen_mismatches':[],'accepted':False,'credit':0},indent=2)+'\n')
for rel,v in manifest.items():assert hashlib.sha256((lane/rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==v['sha256']
print(json.dumps({'sealed_files':len(manifest),'manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path('SEAL.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'self_exclusions':ex,'frozen_count':13,'mismatches':[],'qualified_survivors':0}))
